wheel.built_from: a pristine export of the working tree of the final packaging pass (git ls-files, so exactly the tree the pending commit will hold). The commit does not exist yet: the chief rebuilds from it after committing, and that rebuild's SHA-256 is the definitive publishable digest. The build is reproducible, so it is expected to equal the digest recorded here.

reproducible.detail: a second build, from a second independent export of the same tree into a different directory, produced a byte-identical wheel with the same SHA-256.

placeholder_release_note: The packaged ReleaseCore still declares placeholder_release true, and now names four unbound coordinates rather than five: the host Hermes ceiling is bound, because a version was tested. The four that remain - release_id, cli_version, cli_source_commit and the starter Skill's address - can only be chosen at deploy time, and decision 0023 puts the placeholder_release:false candidate in WP11d, after this wheel exists.
